title: A done agent returns to idle some time after its workspace has been shown
body:
An agent that reports `done` keeps that state until it reports another or the person clears it (`Agents::clear` in `src/server/agents.rs`). The sidebar keeps the workspace near the top and green after Jack has gone to look. decade-ca56f2 chose a timeout that starts once the workspace has been shown.

## Proposal

- When a workspace is shown on the viewer, decade starts a clock on each of its agents that is `done`.
- When the clock runs out, decade returns the agent to idle, as `Agents::clear` does for a click.
- A new report from the agent, of any state, cancels the clock.
- A workspace that is never shown keeps its `done` agents until it is shown or cleared by hand.

## Open

- How long the clock runs.
- Whether the clock keeps running when Jack switches away before it runs out, or stops and starts over on the next show.
- Whether `attention` gets the same treatment, or stays until the agent reports again, since an agent waiting on an answer needs one.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/7403d304
notes.text: Jack agreed: the clock runs 10 minutes, keeps running when he switches away from the workspace, and attention never times out.
